svg.text: 18 nodes · 12 relationships · 17 implied labels, generated from the CASE 1.5.0 and UCO 1.5.0 release Turtle files (GitHub casework/CASE and ucoProject/UCO, tag 1.5.0). The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the term's page in the CASE or UCO documentation.
CASE — investigations, investigative actions, provenance and roles
UCO — the classes CASE extends or points at
required: every source has one or more
every source has at most one
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: ENVIRONMENT: The environment wherein an action occurs. Each Action has at most one UcoObject.
ERROR: A characterization of the differences between the expected and the actual performance of the action. Each Action has zero or more UcoObject.
INSTRUMENT: The things used to perform an action. Each Action has zero or more UcoObject.
OBJECT: The things that the action is performed on/against. Each Action has zero or more UcoObject.
PARTICIPANT: The supporting (non-primary) performers of an action. Each Action has zero or more UcoObject.
PERFORMER: The primary performer of an action. Each Action has at most one UcoObject.
RESULT: The things resulting from performing an action. Each Action has zero or more UcoObject.
SUBACTION: References to other actions that make up part of a larger more complex action. Each Action has zero or more Action.
ERROR: A characterization of the differences between the expected and the actual performance of the action. Each ActionLifecycle has between 0 and 0 UcoObject.
OBJECT: Specifies one or more UcoObjects. Each ContextualCompilation has zero or more UcoObject.
RELEVANT_AUTHORIZATION: Specifies an authorization relevant to a particular investigation. Each Investigation has zero or more Authorization.

WAS_INFORMED_BY: A re-implementation of the wasInformedBy property in W3C PROV-O, where an entity is exchanged by two activities, 'one activity using the entity generated by the other'. [Ref: https://www.w3.org/TR/prov-o/#wasInformedBy]. Each InvestigativeAction has zero or more InvestigativeAction.
Every Action is also a UcoObject
Every ActionLifecycle is also a Action
Every Attorney is also a Role
Every Authorization is also a UcoObject
Every Compilation is also a UcoObject
Every ContextualCompilation is also a Compilation
Every Examiner is also a Role
Every ExaminerActionLifecycle is also a ActionLifecycle
Every Investigation is also a ContextualCompilation
Every InvestigativeAction is also a Action
Every Investigator is also a Role
Every ProvenanceRecord is also a ContextualCompilation
Every Role is also a UcoObject
Every Subject is also a Role
Every SubjectActionLifecycle is also a ActionLifecycle
Every UcoObject is also a UcoThing
Every VictimActionLifecycle is also a ActionLifecycle

g.title: Action — An action is something that may be done or performed. Properties: uri, actionCount, actionStatus, endTime, startTime

ActionLifecycle — An action lifecycle is an action pattern consisting of an ordered set of multiple actions or subordinate action lifecycles. Properties: uri, actionCount, actionStatus, endTime, startTime
Attorney — Attorney is a role involved in preparing, interpreting, and applying law. Properties: uri

Authorization — An authorization is a grouping of characteristics unique to some form of authoritative permission identified for investigative action. Properties: uri, authorizationIdentifier, authorizationType, endTime, startTime
Compilation — A compilation is a grouping of things. Properties: uri

ContextualCompilation — A contextual compilation is a grouping of things sharing some context (e.g., a set of network connections observed on a given day, all accounts associated with a given person). Properties: uri
Examiner — Examiner is a role involved in providing scientific evaluations of evidence that are used to aid law enforcement investigations and court cases. Properties: uri

ExaminerActionLifecycle — An examiner action lifecycle is an action pattern consisting of an ordered set of actions or subordinate action-lifecycles performed by an entity acting in a role involved in providing scientific evaluations of evidence that is used to aid law enforcement investigations and court cases. Properties: uri

Investigation — An investigation is a grouping of characteristics unique to an exploration of the facts involved in a cyber-relevant set of suspicious activity. Properties: uri, endTime, focus, investigationForm, investigationStatus, startTime

InvestigativeAction — An investigative action is something that may be done or performed within the context of an investigation, typically to examine or analyze evidence or other data. Properties: uri
Investigator — Investigator is a role involved in coordinating an investigation. Properties: uri

ProvenanceRecord — A provenance record is a grouping of characteristics unique to the provenantial (chronology of the ownership, custody or location) connection between an investigative action and a set of observations (items and/or actions) or interpretations that result from it. Properties: uri, exhibitNumber, rootExhibitNumber
Role — A role is a usual or customary function based on contextual perspective. Properties: uri
Subject — Subject is a role whose conduct is within the scope of an investigation. Properties: uri

SubjectActionLifecycle — A subject action lifecycle is an action pattern consisting of an ordered set of multiple actions or subordinate action-lifecycles performed by an entity acting in a role whose conduct may be within the scope of an investigation. Properties: uri

UcoObject — A UCO object is a representation of a fundamental concept either directly inherent to the cyber domain or indirectly related to the cyber domain and necessary for contextually characterizing cyber domain concepts and relationships. Within the Unified Cyber Ontology (UCO) structure this is the base class acting as a consistent, unifying and interoperable foundation for all explicit and inter-relatable content objects. Properties: uri, description, modifiedTime, name, objectCreatedTime, objectStatus, specVersion, tag
UcoThing — UcoThing is the top-level class for individuals within UCO. Properties: uri

VictimActionLifecycle — A victim action lifecycle is an action pattern consisting of an ordered set of multiple actions or subordinate action-lifecycles performed by an entity acting in a role characterized by its potential to be harmed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action. Properties: uri
